name: Gabor Fields
definition: A Gabor Field is a single continuous decomposition consisting of a low-pass, high-density volume of Gaussians (zero-ω Gabors) plus a residual of Gabor kernels carrying higher frequencies.
summary: Gabor Fields are a continuous volumetric representation using Gaussian bases and Gabor residuals for orientation-selective level-of-detail, achieving higher PSNR and faster rendering than standard Gaussian methods.
